slots.node01.text: Each stage builds on the last. Early stages take effort and show little; the climb steepens once practice is shared.
slots.node02.stages.item01.label: Ad hoc
slots.node02.stages.item01.text: Work depends on individuals and varies by team.
slots.node02.stages.item02.label: Defined
slots.node02.stages.item02.text: Standard methods are written down and taught.
slots.node02.stages.item03.label: Managed
slots.node02.stages.item03.text: Teams measure results and correct course.
slots.node02.stages.item04.label: Optimized
slots.title: Four stages take the practice from ad hoc to optimized
